title: Avro Lancaster LM311
memorial_details:
description: A metal plaque attached to a backboard, mounted on a rough hewn stone  on a concrete base. Lettering is incised and picked out in black.

The plaque refers to a memorial tree, probably a Eucalyptus planted in 1995.  By 2015 an immature sapling was recorded, presumably having replaced the original tree.  By December 2020 the sapling was no longer in evidence (presumed dead).
